data.text: I’m in. I’ll catch 15 tons today and pay the full $15,000 directly to the clinic, then limit my catch to 7.5 tons next month. With Luke’s zero catch both months, that completes our agreement. Let’s record the catches and clinic payments together so we all know we’ve followed through. Once the lake recovers, we return to a 50-ton group limit—10 tons each. My family taught me that looking after our neighbors and protecting our livelihood go hand in hand.
